prose: Get ready to be initiated into the mysteries of the Great Whiteboard Brotherhood, the mystical sync-tank of our boy Slick Dissident. Tonight we take aim at the new word order imposed by centuries of linguistic drift that's gradually transferred power from verb to noun. What happens when you use Hume's Guillotine on Occam's Razor? Just because a noun represents us, ought we believe that we are our pronouns? Prepare for profound pronouncements on the primary problems of philosophy.
